evidence.note: Schofield states that this fourth-tetralogy work is not regarded as authentic by modern scholarship.
Jażdżewska treats Rival Lovers among the Platonic dubia and discusses its deviations from genuine works.

rationale: Rival Lovers (Amatores/Erastae) is generally rejected as Platonic while remaining part of the ancient tetralogical canon. C preserves that distinction.
